AE2 and all of it's Addons!

Starting Applied Energistics
&7The charger has some smaller Recipes, the Charger itself has no interface and using a Hopper or other item transportation way is recommended.
Craft a Charger
&7This little Compass only leads you to Meteorites.
Craft a Meteorite Compass
Find a Meteorite and loot its Core!
Find a Meteorite
&7The first step to start your Storage and Processing, is to find a meteorite.
&7Finding a meteorite is quite easy with the tools provided by Applied Energistics as well as the Explorers Compass.
Locating a Meteorite
Good ol' Reliable
&7The Hand Crank is the simplest way of powering a Charger, it's also the worst. Please only use this until you find a better solution.
&7Other power solutions also include the Generator from Tech Reborn, Solar Panels, Wind mills and even Water Mills.
Other Power solutions
&7Finding the Patterns is the most important part, as without them, it's impossible to progress any further. You can always dupe the presses.
Find Inscriber Presses
&7The Inscriber is a crucial machine and the first machine with a set in and output.
&7All Circuits need a Press, the Press is not consumed.
&7Combining them always requires Redstone.
Growing Certus
&7Growing Certus is easier than one can think.
&7Doing so permanently, can be annoying, since Flawless Certus Blocks cannot be mined.
Moving Flawless Certus the Create way
&7Moving Certus without and Power is nearly impossible. The only way is to use a Minecart Contraption.
&7Place the Rail directly under the Flawless Certus Block, then place the Minecart Assembler on it, then place the Minecart and give the entire thing a Redstone Signal.
&7Once done, you should be able to pick up the Contraption
&7You can use this method to move a ton of things.
&7Certus charged in the Charger becomes Charged Certus. (say that 3 times fast)
&7This can be used mainly for specific items and also in crafting Fluix.
&7Without Fluix, you won't have cables, without cables, you wont have anything.
&7Fluix is incredibly useful in both its Crystaline and Dust form. Many different Items and Blocks require Fluix, now and also further down the line.
&7Mostly used for Formation Planes and Export buses.
&7Mostly used for Annihilation Planes and Import buses.
&7Growth Accelerators are a farmer's best friend. They speed up growth of most, if not all Plants, but also Certus. Placing them can be hard, but is made easier with a wrench.
&7They need to be connected with Fluix ME Cables in order to recieve energy to work.

&7The Crystal Resonance Generator is the easiest way to power tiny AE2 systems or smaller subnets, without having them dependant on the bigger one. This little guy also needs no power, with a whopping 20 AE it can it's own.
&7Certus Quartz is the heart of Applied Energistics. Without it, the mod would basically be useless.
&7Farming Certus is one of the most important things, so you can expand your AE2 System.
&7It's best if you start farming as soon as possible.
&7Made in the Inscriber, this is a vital component to everything in AE2
&7Glass, but no liner.
&7Glows, thats basically it.
&7Unlike all other mods using Power(Ignoring Botania), AE2 has a conversion rate of 1 E = 2 AE.
Applied Energistics Power
&7Sky Stone is a crucial Component to making a ME Controller.
&7Sky Stone can be mined in a Meteorite.
&7A more advanced alternative is placing a Annihilation Plane facing the sky at build height.
Collect Sky Stone
&7This little guy can be crafted with a Singularity and some presses, quite expensive, but you'll learn more about that later.
&7Quartz Fiber is not a cable yet, but it can be used to only transport power into a subnet for example.
Your First AE2 System
&aDifficulty: Easy&r
&7This is the most simple AE2 System you can make. It has space for 10 ME Storage Cells.
&7This Quest serves more as a checklist.
&7You can place the Resonance Chamber directly onto the ME Controller.
&7The Fluix ME Glass Cable is the first cable and holds 8 Channels.
&7This is the starting point for SpatialIO.
&7Spatial IO lets you move almost everything. It has a pocket dimension that it uses to store.
&7Whilst this Quest Page won't go over all the details, Spatial IO is pretty confusing and not recommended for beginners.

&7To perform a spatial IO operation, place a spatial storage cell in the input slot and give the spatial IO port a redstone pulse. It will then swap the volume in the pylons with the volume in the spatial storage dimension. This means that if you send some set of blocks to the spatial storage dimension, then put another set of blocks in the pylons, put the cell back in the input slot, and trigger the IO port again, the 2nd set of blocks will disappear and the 1st set of blcks will reappear.

&7&9BE CAREFUL&r&7, Any entity in the defined volume, including you, will be carried along, and if you have no way of getting out, you will be trapped in the spatial storage dimension, in a dark, featureless box. Use this to prank your friends!
&7The ME drive can hold up to 10 Storage Cells of any type, meaning Fluid, Item or else.
&7Same as the normal one, but covered.
&7Same Channel amount as the basic one, this Cable shows you how many Channels you have left.
&7A Thicker Cable that has a total of 32 Channels.
&7Like the normal Dense ME Cable, this one also has 32 Channels, but like the normal Smart cable, you can see how many you have left.
Your first Spatial setup
&7This should be everything you need for your first Spatial Setup to move something or someone.
&9Rules&r
&7The rules are:
&7Minimum size of 3x3x3 (which defines a 1x1x1 volume)
&7All spatial pylons must be in the outside bounding box
&7All spatial pylons must be on the same network
&7All pylons must be at least 2 blocks long
Any Button
Power Solutions
&7Powering your AE2 can be done with a lot of methods, Magmators being the best, since they do not need much Maintenance, as a matter of fact they don't need any.
&7Wind and Water Mills are a great way to power your AE2 system aswell, though are less scale-able and less efficient, but lazier.
&7Solar Panels fill a nice niche between convenience and efficiency, with the only downside being that they only work at Daytime.
Power Solutions
More Space and Wireless
&aDifficulty: Easy&r
&7Use this quest as a checklist.
&7This is all the items required for a more advanced setup, IGNORING any energy requirements.
&9With this setup you will be able to access your Storage from anywhere, at any time, no matter what dimension you are.&r&n&l
&7Cables not included
&7Check the individual quests for the items for more info.
&7Now that you can access your AE2 from everywhere, there is one small thing you need to keep in mind.
&7You AE2 System can only load when its Chunkloaded/you are loading it, otherwise it will not work.
&7This can be done in 2 main ways, the Spatial Anchor or by Claiming and Forceloading the chunk it is in via the map. Highly recommended you also claim the Chunks where your power is in.
About loading chunks and your AE2
&7Channels are what keeps AE2 "balanced". Basic cables have 8 channels and Dense Cables have 32. Once above the limit, the newly plugged in machines won't work.
About Channels
The ME Controller
The Heart of your system
&7The ME Controller is the Heart of every AE2 system. you can add multiple controllers into one Multiblock.
&7This Multiblock can reach a size of 7x7x7. If you make an invalid Multiblock, it will turn red.
&7Consult the graph to the right of the Quest for more info!
Autocrafting in your Storage
&aDifficulty: Medium&r
&7If you are adept at Tech and AE2, which you should be at this point, this should be a breeze for you to do.
&7If you hate crafting large orders yourself, Autocrafting is great for you to take that time from you.
&9Cables, once again, not included&r
Make sure to read the quest about
automation - click me!
&7The Patternb Encoding Terminal is only needed for creating Crafting and Processing Patterns for Autocrafting, if you do not wish to use Autocrafting, then this is useless for you.
&7Crafting units are not actual functional blocks, they are only filler blocks for autocrafting and crafting components for Crafting CPUs.
&7This is used for autocrafting. You need to encode it in a Pattern Encoding Terminal to make this useful, can be wiped by sneak right clicking or just by overwriting it in the Encoding Terminal.
&7Can do more things at once.
&7Double it and give it to the next Extended ME Drive.
&7This increases the ME Drive capacity to 20.
&7Crafting Co-Processing Units increase the speed at which Pattern Providers put items into the adjacent machine. They do not increase crafting speed, if the machine is too slow.

&7Similar to storage cells, these Crafting Storage blocks, have bytes too. This means, the bigger and more complicated your Pattern is, the more bytes are consumed. This obviously also increases with the amount you craft an item.
&7Now i want you to be honest with me, why would you EVER need this much crafting storage?????
&7This thing is basically a Import bus and a Export bus in one.
&7Export busses send items from the ME System &lOUT&r &7of the System
&7Import Buses take items out of inventories and brings them &linto&r &7the ME system

&7The Storage Bus is a very unique AE2 block, as it can make any storage that it is connected to, into a "Storage Cell". This means you can format it, you can access it from your AE2 system and you can also filter it, via Storages buses, like the Tag Storage bus.
&7Same as the Terminal before, just with a crafting Grid.
Obtain a Wireless Terminal
Wifi but for Storage
&7To pair a Wireless Terminal, simply insert it into the Wireless Access Point.
&7Make sure the Wireless Access point is connected to your ME system.
&7The Wireless Access point is unfortunately not optional, you will have to craft it regardless - whether you wanna stay here or go cross dimensional. You need it to pair.
&7One of the two components for a Quantum Link Chamber.
&7One of the two components for a Quantum Link Chamber.
&7Do you want to access your storage from anywhere? In another dimension, at your friends base, or even during a teamfight because you forgot food?
&7Look no further as the Quantum Card(and the things you need to make it to work.)

&7The Magnet card gives insane utility to the Wireless Terminal. Not only are you the Number one Thief, but you can also pick up items from incredibly far away, you can even choose if it sends the items into your ME system or into your inventory, there is nothing that makes Mining easier!
FASTER FASTER
&7Acceleration Cards are the best friend of anyone who likes not wasting their time watching some Inscribers do their job. They are a Must-Have for anyone who plans big.
Terminal but Phone
&7The Wireless Terminal is the first step towards access to all of your storage. It can only access the Storage and can't craft.
&7Makes you store more energy into your Terminal.
&7Same thing but even bigger energy storage.
&7The Matter Condenser can be used to make Singularities, as a trash can and also to make Matter Balls, used by the Matter Cannon, a pretty fun and lethal Ranged weapon.
&7This Terminal can access every single Pattern Provider that you have in your AE2 System. It is a great tool for massive Systems with many duplicate Machines and such.
&7Pattern Providers are placed next to machines to make them send the items from the Processing Pattern to the Machine. They also collect the items, if able.
&7This has 4x the Slots the normal Pattern Provider has, great value!
&7Pattern Providers work by doing the job they are told to- this means, for example:
&7Turn Logs into Planks

&7The Pattern Provider will send the Log to the adjacent machine(s) and expects that in the future, it will get the specified amount of Planks. How it gets these planks doesnt matter. The process is only done once the ME System has obtained that specific amount of Planks.
&n&7Make sure to set in and outputs of machines and allow them to be automated!!!!&r
Automating other machines
&7The Quantum Entangled Singularity always comes in pairs, this means these Pairs are premanently intertwined.
&7If you want to use it with your Terminal, simply place one into the Slot in your Wireless Terminal (requires the quantum card!). Place the second one into a Quantum Chamber inside the Quantum ring
&7If you want to make a Quantum Tunnel, place one of them into the first Quantum Ring, and the other one gets the other.
&7&nEvery Terminal needs its own Quantum Ring, quantum card and pair of Singularities. If you want to make one for your friend you will need to craft everything another time.&r
&7&9Make sure to rename your Singularities!&r
&7The Wireless Connector is the greatest way of saving you from a Spaghetti base. Simply pair them in a 255 block range and load both parts and you will be fine.
&7This is used to pair two Wireless Connectors together.
&7You have older lower tier Storage Cells you wanna get empty? This is the item for you, increase the speed with Acceleration Cards.
Stacking NBTS
Please Read me
&7Whilst Storage Buses have great versatility, you must consider one thing:
&7Storing many unstackable items in things like the Item Vault from create, is great for convenience, but horrible for servers - please be responsible with your storages.
Stabby Stab
&7Whilst not the best for shanking, its great for making Cable Anchors
&7These little guys are used to seperate cables. Sometimes you dont want to have a cable touch another, so you use one of these.
Making Things Pretty
&7Don't like Cables everywhere? Every block can be made into a Facade, so you can hide cables efficiently.
Any Facade

&7Now you may ponder as to how you can charge your Terminal effectively. The Easiest way is a Battery Box from Tech reborn. Once you have made it Quantum entangled, you no longer need to charge it, as it draws power from the AE2 System itself.
Powering the Terminal
Getting the Matter Condenser full

&7Filling the Matter condenser is best done with one of the Infinity Item Cells, as you don't need much to make them. They are not only great to export infinite cobble or water into the Matter condenser, but also great for a Recycler Setup from Tech Reborn. Highly recommended for making more than 1 Singularity.
Energy Storage for ME Systems

&7There is two main ways of storing power. Many Players opt into not storing any, but the Energy Cells from AE2 or the Ender Cells(insert a Battery into them!) are the most commonly used ways to store.
Like Airsoft but lethal
&7And not as bad for the environment.
&7The Matter Cannon is a fun Ranged weapon that scales with Ranged damage.
Lets Go Gambling!
&7If you feel lucky, you may get your storage upgrade, or maybe not.

ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.title: &e Backpacks
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.525D2B: This Quest is Unlocked once you have crafted a Backpack
&7Traveler's Backpacks are the best way to carry more loot around you.
&7Can be accessed by holding it in the Main hand and right-clicking
&7The Backpack is equippable on the back by clicking the "Equip" button in the backpack GUI, located on the right side just above the player's inventory slots.
&7Though, this storage comes at a price:
&7You can only carry &9one&r &7backpack equipped and &93&r &7more in your inventory, &9otherwise you will get slowness&r
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.72D150: &7This backpack gives a 15% to double the amount of incoming experience if worn
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.62CCFD: &7This Backpack provides maximum strength redstone signals if worn
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.253BC2: &7Can be played like a bookshelf around an Enchanting table to get the bonus of 5 Bookshelves.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.5AA5A8: &7Works like sponge and additionally fills tank with every water block collected until tanks are full.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.2E5602: &7Restores full hunger and grants Regeneration I for 10 seconds. Cooldown is random.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.55BA48: &7If the backpack is placed on the ground and it's raining, it will fill tanks with speed of 1ml per 5 ticks. If player wears backpack and it's raining, it will fill with speed of 1 ml per 5 ticks, if player is under water it will with speed of 2ml per 5 ticks.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.04A41F: &7When harvested, there's random chance to spawn 0 to 3 melon slices. The cooldown is randomly selected from range of 2 minutes to 6 minutes
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.11F857: &7When worn, Endermen no longer aggro on you. Does the same as the End Veil Enchantment.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.087E23: &7When worn, it prevents the player from dying, setting the player back to 1 HP, removing all negative effects, granting Regeneration 2, Absorption 2 and fire Resistance. Also blows up, dealing damage to mobs around you.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.2118FF: &7When worn, gives the wearer Regeneration 1 and Strength 1.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.390F2A: &7Extends your building range by 1. &nDoes not work with Combat.&r
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.17ADE9: &7Grants the wearer immunity to fall damage, removes small fireballs sent by blazes if they hit the player.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.742D6E: &7When worn, Ghasts will not attack the player first, unless they are being attacked.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.13D2C1: &7Allows wearer to climb walls just like ladders.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.15DBE7: &7Removes inflicted wither effect from the wearer and applies Wither II for 3 seconds to attacked enemies.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.4330E3: &7Gives the wearer Night vision, similar to the Monocle or the Night Vision Goggles.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.0D1829: &7When worn, stings the attacked creature with strength of 1 heart, increases stinger count in attacked creature (if possible) and grants poison I for 4 seconds
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.1C3BBB: &7When the wearer is near Hostile mobs, gain Speed 1.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.232519: &7Cleanses many negative effects. The cooldown is between 7.5 minutes and 10 minutes.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.2A8A54: &7When worn, spawns an egg every 6-10 minutes. Why??
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.46F38D: &7Grants the wearer Water Breathing I and Night Vision I while being in water.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.632344: &7Some backpacks are only really cosmetic. Whilst they don't have Abilities, they can still obviously carry items.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.3317F6: &7Don't like how your backpack looks? Just use the Transmogging table and make it look like another backpack!
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.3226DF: &7Upgrading Backpacks is incredibly easy and is done in a Smithing Table.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.33A696: &7These upgrades increase the amount of slots a backpack has. Highly recommended to do.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.3C406D: &7Enhances the backpack with two fluid tanks.
&7Fluids can be added through the upgrade tab slots or by holding a fluid container at the cursor and clicking on the desired tank.
&7Potions can be stored in the tank, preserving their effects and allowing them to be used with a hose in drink mode.
&7Splash and lingering potions can also be stored and used with the hose in spill mode to throw them into the world.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.0E3D4F: &7Adds a crafting grid to the backpack.
&7An arrow in the upgrade tab determines whether the crafted item goes to the backpack or the player's inventory when shift-clicked.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.515838: &7Adds a furnace to the backpack. Works like a standard furnace.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.35B09A: &7Adds a smoker to the backpack. Works like a standard smoker (cooks food faster).
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.3F6203: &7Adds a blast furnace to the backpack. Works like a standard blast furnace (smelts ores faster).
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.339339: &7Feeds the player with food from the backpack.
&7Applying upgrade without changing the filter settings will eat every food from the backpack, starting from the top - foods with negative effects are ignored.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.132F13: &7Allows items to be picked up from the ground and stored directly in the backpack.
&7Applying upgrade without changing the filter settings will pickup all items and place them in the backpack storage.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.04BB18: &7Pulls nearby items to the player in a radius of 5 blocks (Pull range can be changed in config)
&7Applying upgrade without changing the filter settings will pull all detected items to the player.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.5B6AB9: &7Provides a trash slot for manual item deletion and filters to automatically void items when they enter the backpack via the Pickup Upgrade or hoppers.
&7Applying upgrade without changing the filter settings will not void any items. Add an item to the filter slot to have it voided when it enters the backpack via the Pickup Upgrade or a Hopper.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.5AABB5: &7Accepts only music disks in the slot.
&7Music is available only for player who wears the backpack, other players do not hear the music.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.58B7EE: &7The hose can be used with the Tank upgrades.
&7Suck Mode - You can pick up fluid from the world or - when clicking on a suitable tank - transfer fluid from the clicked tank to your backpack's tank.
&7Spill Mode - You can spill fluid into the world or - when clicking on a suitable tank - transfer fluid from your backpack's tank to the clicked tank.
&7Drink Mode - Allows the player to drink the contents of certain tanks - not all fluids are drinkable, and some of them may give special effects.
&7If you hold the Hose item in your main hand and have the backpack equipped, press Z (configurable in controls) to open the mode/tank selection wheel.
ftbquests.chapter.backpacks.quest.2D1028: &7If you do not like the backpack you got/crafted, you can always place it down, use shears on it and it will reveert to a Standard Travelers Backpack.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.title: &aBotania
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.37BA64F1: It's time for you to play with nature. What we're going to be looking at is how to make use of the natural mana and soil to gain powerful artifacts and maybe farms. Are you ready?
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.34B46C9D: Getting a Lexica Botanica will help you understand the natural world around us. Getting one will be important to progress.
Don't forget to check the Advancements for more hints too.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.4FFB7046: A Flower Pouch is important to have as you will be collecting different colored flowers and it will clog your inventory so a pouch for them is perfect.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.261D2652: The Petal Apothecary is an important item used to creating certain items that will be beneficial to your progression.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.5E839705: The Pure Daisy is a plant that can 'purify' or tranform any log and stone into materials used to craft more sophisticated tools.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.3F7946DA: Good start! Now you are ready to generate mana. Be sure to try out the different kinds of flowers as well for fun!
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.409E5C47: Now you created a flower with a unique function, good start! Now you can make interesting rituals and creations using these flowers as the base so try out the different kinds of flora with unique properties.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.3C992A84: This plate is a very special item that is used to create a new ingot by infusing three mana dipped objects. One must use up half a mana pool's capacity in order for it to function properly. Be warned that the ritual will be wasted if the items aren't on the plate.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.0179EA08: The Runic Altar is an important item that allows the creation of runes that are used in various tools. You must have it connected with a mana pool and materials to create a certain rune to function.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.4DA3A0F1: The Wand of the Forest is an important item to carry around when commanding or redirecting magical items and mana pools to perform a certain function.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.3E314714: I thought we can swim in this?
A Mana Pool is an important item to have as they are used to store in generated or transferred mana in order to be used later.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.798E0366: A Mana Spreader is a block that can transfer mana to nearby blocks or structures that can hold mana. They can be rotated or facing a certain block by using the Wand of the Forest.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.62A2CFC3: A Mana Tablet is used to be able to carry mana around as a portable object and can be used to absorb or deposit mana. Each tablet can hold about half a mana pool's capacity.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.357C1191: A Terrasteel Ingot is a special ingot that can be used to create a stronger variant of tools made using manasteel ingots, but they're very expensive to create.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.57FA3D91: These Manasteel Tools are better than iron and can make use of mana to repair itself.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.637DEA86: Just like the tools, the Manasteel Armor is better than iron and makes use of mana to repair itself.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.1F89E3F1: This armor set is a specialized set of manasteel armor that makes the cost of mana lesser than the other mana set, only that this armor is weaker in defense.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.5F8A567D: There are only three weapons for the terrasteel, but they're stronger than their manasteel variant. Also, do your best to raise the rank of your Terra Shatterer.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.22E1A9CE: The highest rank attainable, such a powerful pickaxe that can drill through the heavens and the earth!
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.623C9F71: This Terrasteel Armor is a stronger version of the Manasteel Armor that can also passively charge your Mana Tablets in your inventory.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.6D83B47F: Congratulations, you have defeated the boss and now have your rewards. Maybe there's a hard mode with more rewards?
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.102F5687: If you use this, you will have to fight the boss again but harder, are you ready?
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.469F1443: Congratulations, now you earn a chance to gain an artifact, can you collect them all?
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.6C346F03: Doing this fight without armor is terrifying. I hope you fought it without creative mode.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.21F4456C: This is the better version of the Mana Spreader that you'll craft. More mana payout. Oh, and do try out the different lens that you can attach to your Mana Spreaders.
ftbquests.chapter.botania.quest.479B4CE3: This is the best mana spreader that Mother Earth can provide for your needs. This is much slower but its payout is much higher.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.title: &c Witchcraft \& Rituals
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.subtitle: Enchanted:Witchcraft
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.7B: Herbalism - mutating and mixing them is a core Feature of Enchanted:Witchcraft
&7All Seeds can be obtained by breaking grass with a Hoe.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.79: Mutandis is a mutagen used to mutate plants into other species you could not normally obtain. Using this substance on a small plant such as grass, saplings and flowers will mutate it into another.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.47: Mutandis Extremis, an enhanced form of mutandis, is able to mutate multi-stage plants such as cactus, sugar cane and wheat. Additionally, it can do everything normal mutandis can do.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.3B: Alder trees, of the Alnus genus, are monoecious trees distributes throughout the north temperature zone thought to bleed when cut as the white wood can turn red.
&7This tree is thought to be both a bringer of misfortune and a repellent of negativity.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.0B: Ember Moss of the Takakia genus is a plant which has a very peculiar and unique defense mechanism where it bursts into flames at the slightest touch of disturbance.
&7Should be harvested with shears to avoid destruction
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.78: This magical weed which emits a glow around it, acting like a torch, can survive on nearly any surface but only spreads on grass, dirt and sand.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.64: This species of crataegus, commonly referred to as Hawthorn, is native to the northern hemisphere and known as a tree of purity.
&7In addition to herbal uses, hawthorn is known to be an effective material for dispatching vampires.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.24: The rowan, or mountain-ash, a small deciduous tree native to the northern hemisphere, has many uses in witchcraft andf occultism.
&7 The magical affinity of the Rowan is seldom matched by other trees, and is thought to give protection against malevolant beings.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.15: An epiphytic flowering plant, similar to a moss or lichen, found growing on trees in tropical or subtropical climates. Spanish Moss is often used in the creation of Poppets.
&7Should be harvested with shears to be kept intact
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.40: Atropa Belladonna, commonly known as deadly nightshade, is a poisonous member of the Solanaceae family.
&7The foliage and berries of this plant are known to be extremely toxic to humans and should be handled with care.
&7Known to be dropped by Tall Grass.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.46: Garlic, a species of bulbous flowering plant in the Allium genus, is a best known for it's use as seasoning in many cuisines.
&7 A lesser known use of this plant is being a strong repellent for vampiric beings.
&7Known to be dropped by Tall grass.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.55: Mandrakes are a group of perennial herbaceous plants with long, parsnip shaped roots. You will hate the screams.
&7The screams of this plant can cause injury or death. Wear earmuffs and harvest at night to reduce risk.
&7Known to be dropped by Tall Grass.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.68: Snowbell, or Sytrax, is a grenus of large shrubs from the Styracaceae family. Despite the name, they are native to warm climates.
&7Their Resin is used for purification, dispelling anger or soothing tension.
&7Known to be dropped by Tall Grass.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.01: This subspecies of the common Artichoke only grows on still water. Unlike it's green cousin, it is not considered edible.
&7Consumption of this plant will satiate hunger but empty your stomach.
&7Known to be dropped by Tall Grass.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.7B: Aconitum, common name of Wolfsbane, refers to many flowering plants native to mountainous areas of the northern hemisphere.
&7Wolfsbane roots contain a substantial amount of aconitine, a potent neurotoxin and cardiotoxin.
&7Known to be dropped by Tall Grass.
&7The altar is an essential device used by Witches and Warlocks to collect magical energy from nature around them. Six altar blocks must be placed in a 3x2 rectangle to form a valid altar.
&7An altar may be upgraded by placing specific items on top of it, these are detailed later.
&7 See Extraction to find out more about materials needed to make an Altar.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.03: &7A chalice may be placed on the altar to increase power capacity.
&7A chalice may be filled by using Redstone Soup on it.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.5F: &7Skulls are able to enhance both the capacity and recharge rate of an altar, with varying effectiveness.
Skeleton: +1x Power Capacity and +1x Recharge Rate
Wither: +2x Power Capactiy and +2x Recharge Rate
Player: +2.5 Power Capacity and +3x Recharge Rate
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.7E: &7One upgrade from the torch category may be placed on an altar, the benefits of each upgrade in this category are as follows:
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.52: &7One of the essential skills for a Witch is being able to create brews in cauldrons and kettles.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.03: &7The kettle, similar to the witch's cauldron, is a type of brewing apparatus used primarily to create infusions but may have other uses.
&7Kettles require altar power and a sufficient heat source to function.
&7A lack of sufficient power or heat will make a brew spoil, and must be removed before the kettle is used again.

&7A brew or infusion may be created by filling the kettle with water and dropping the correct items in the correct order into the kettle. Brews can be collected with empty glass bottles once complete.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.23: &7The Witch's Cauldron is an upgraded cauldron used to create magical substances and brews.
&7The cauldron must be placed over a heat source to boil and may require altar power.
&7If a cauldron does not have sufficient heat or power, the brew will turn brown and spoil, which must be removed.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.24: &7Many resources used in the art of Witchcraft or other magical practices requires the extraction of magical properties or materials from seemingly mundane objects. This part details the two main processes; fume collection and distillation.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.6D: &7This brew can be thrown to cause all nearby animals to become infatuated.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.1C: &7This brew can be thrown to cause a branch to sprout from the ground where it lands.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.26: &7Drinking this brew will grant the ability to breathe underwater for a few minutes.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.2A: &7This brew makes the drinker unrecognisably grotesque, preventing nearby mobs from approaching.
&7Additionally actas as a base for most curses.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.6A: &7Flying ointment is a liquid which seems to defy gravity. Anything imbued with it will gain the property of flight, including players who drink it.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.75: &7Happenstance Oil is said to let witches look into the future and is as such used to infuse Crystal Balls.
&7Consuming this will give night vision for a short time.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.67: &7Mystic Unguent is a curious concoction which allows an object to give form to thoughts.
&7Used in a mystic branch infusion, consuming this will weaken you.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.11: &7Redstone Soup acts as a base for other infusions and brews, it seems to have very few effects outside of this.
&7Drinking Redstone Soup can increase your health for a short time.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.59: &7Soul of the World is a derivation of redstone soup, imbued with nature's energy, used for human infusions.
&7This infusion is extremely toxic and should not be consumed.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.19: &7Spirit of Otherwhere is another derivation of redstone soup, imbued with the same properties as the End and it's inhabitants.
&7This infusion is extremely toxic and should not be consumed.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.05: Mutandis is a mutagen used to mutate plants into other species you could not normally obtain. Using this substance on a small plant such as grass, saplings and flowers will mutate it into another.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.08: Mutandis Extremis, an enhanced form of mutandis, is able to mutate multi-stage plants such as cactus, sugar cane and wheat. Additionally, it can do everything normal mutandis can do.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.10: &7Use anointing paste on a regular cauldron to turn it into a Witch's Cauldron.
&7A brew may be created by filling the cauldron with water and dropping the correct items in the correct order into the cauldron.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.1A: &7Another use for a Witch's Cauldron is to boil food to cook it without requiring fuel. This is an effecttive method of cooking and works on most food.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.01: &7Drop of luck is a liquid which enhances the luck of anybody who drinks it, and can be used in rites or the creation of magickal items. Its main uses are in brews.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.13: &7Golden Chalk is used to create the Heart Glyph of a magic circle, which must be right click to be activated. No rite will function without a heart glyph.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.40: &7Infernal Chalk, or also called Nether Chalk, is a deep red chalk which appears to be burning.
&7Infernal Chalk is used for most rites involving the Nether, demonic beings or dire.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.43: &7While expensive, Nether Warts can be synthesized in a Cauldron in the case that the Witch cannot find any via normal means.
&7It is recommended not to do this as it is both expensive and ineffective.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.1B: &7Otherwhere Chalk is a rich purple chalk, typically used for rites involving teleportation/transposition, relocation or the End of time(End).
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.15: &7This section details the Witch Oven and its byproducts used for magical purposes.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.50: Did i forget to turn off the oven?
&7The Witch's Oven is a modified furnace used to collect byproducts in a clay jar. Unline a furnace, this Oven cannot process ores.
&7Fume funnels and filtered fume funnels may be placed on each side to increase byproduct yield.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.1B: &7Birch is a tree of healing and protection. Due to its silvery appearance, this tree is sometimes called the "White Lady of the Woods" and is associated with the Goddess Brigid.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.2B: &7The Horned God, sometimes called The Oak King is a Wiccan deity based on Cernunnos, symbolising wisdom, youth and strength.
&7The Fumes produced by oaks are said to be the Horned God's exhale, carrying some of the properties associated with him.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.2C: &7Sulfur dioxide, reffered to as Foul Fumes, is a colorless gas with a very pungent odor.
&7Can be toxic at high concentrations, witches should avoid opening the jar.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.08: &7In celtic lore, Spruce Trees are associated with the birth of the divine child and are as such a symbol of rebirth, a common theme within Tree mythology.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.0E: &7Hawthorn can be used to collect a powerful purifying agent called Ordour of Purity, which is used in the creattion of any pure substances.
&7This Tree is sacred to the Goddesses Aine and Brigid.
ftbquests.chapter.c_bewitchment.quest.00: &7The highly sacred Alder Tree symbolising nature itself appears to bleed when cut, brings misfortune to all. It is thought that the tree contains the souls of some ancestors.
&7The fumes produced from burrning can be collected, keeping this effect.

&eHow do I know what gear to get?

&7The following guides will direct you what to look for depending on specific build types. These are not fully fleshed builds, they're just guides for you to follow on what gear to choose depending on your gameplay.
&eThe difficulty shown applies to both how hard it is to play it, and how hard it is to make the build &7(Although gameplay difficulty has more priority)&7.

&6For full guides on specific builds, check the official wiki!
&7Stats, also known as attributes, are a series of numbers associated to your character which allow other things to scale from.
&7For example, Haste defines how fast you attack, while health defines how much health you have, etc.
&7The next quests will explain the main stats and how each is important for what use specifically.
&eStats are a core part of your gear, it's important that you understand what stats you need and which you don't depending how you want to build yourself.
&eCore Stats are the stats that everyone uses to an extent.
&7Either because you already have a default amount (like Health) or because any piece of gear will give the stat (like Haste and Armor)
&eVarious statistics that are designed for ranged options.
&7While Physical Damage is used by everyone, ranged builds will prefer other statistics depending on what path they take; &eArchery&7 (Ranged Physical) or &eSpellcasting &7(Ranged Magic)
&7Magic can also be used by melee, with Spellblade builds.
&7Making you attack or switch weapons faster. It also scales with certain weapons and items. Particular focus for "Rogue" builds, or any fast attacking build.
&eIncreases the amount of damage your swings/punches deal.
&7The main statistic for melee builds, as it increases the damage you deal and scales with anything that deals physical damage, such as melee weapons and melee abilities.
&7It's obtained from armor pieces, but enemies and bosses will also have an amount armor by default.
&7Reduces the incoming &6Physical Damage&7 at a higher range. It's more effective on high damage hits, hence why it's known as the "Anti One Shot" stat.
&7Increases the maximum amount of damage you can take until you die.
&7Decreases the amount of Energy (Hunger) you lose passively.
&eElemental powers are the third strongest to exist, also known as &otertiary&r&e powers.
&7Although there are other tertiary powers, Elemental ones come from the Creation, Holy and Soul.
&eArcane, Frost and Fire&7 can be used by various Spell Books, alone or together, they're all three part of the &eAstral &7hybrid power.
&eLightning&7 is used by some weapons like the Thunderwrath artifact, consists of an important power for Valkyries.
&ePrimordial Powers are the second strongest, also known as Secondary powers.
&eHoly&7 is used by Priests and Paladins to support allies.
&eSoul&7 is used in combination of Elemental powers, to form hybrid powers such as &eSoulfire&7 and &eSoulfrost&7, used mainly by some Artifacts.
&eDecaying powers are the powers of Death.
&eBlood&7 is used by Blood Death Knights, a tank specialization that sustains itself.
&eUnholy&7 is used by Unholy Death Knights, bruisers that bring diseases to enemies.
&eHybrid stats either are a mix of two stats, or a stat that applies globally to both melee and ranged classes.
&eLethality and Magic Penetration are the same stat with different names. They ignore a percentage of your target's Armor or Magic Protection.
&7For example, if you have 16% Lethality and your enemy has 100 armor, you'll hit them as if they had 84 Armor instead (as it reduces their armor -16%).
&eAstral Power is the combination of 3 elemental powers: &dArcane, &cFire&e and &bFrost&e.
&7This hybrid power is used by Astral Mages, or by Astral Spellblades. With artifacts such as &dSingularity&8 (from Ekavar)&7 and &dSupernova&7 scaling with these stats.
&7There are spell books that use Astral Power too, such as the &dRunic Invocations&7 book.
&7Increases the specific spell power by a percentage of your Physical Damage.
&7Increases your Phyiscal Damage by a percentage of your amount of the specified spell power.
&7This stat scales the damage dealt with Ranged Weapons that throw projectiles, such as bows, crossbows or guns. It's obtained through Talents, Jewelry and from the ranged weapons themselves.
&7This stat increases the draw speed from a bow/crossbow, or the rate of fire from guns/cannons.
&eThese powers buff the casting process of Spellcaster Mages.
&eSpell Critical Chance&7 increases the chance of your spells to deal critical damage.
&eSpell Critical Damage&7 increases the damage of your critical spells by a percentage.
&eSpell Haste&7 increases the speed of your casts, making them shorter.
&7It also scales with other things like Rolling.
&eEnchantments are a core part of your gear, they heavily increase the efficiency of your gear.
&7You can check the full enchanting guide on the wiki, the Enchanting tutorial is currently being built <3
&eProtectors (Also called Tanks) are supports that focus on protecting others by taking the damage from enemies.
&7Protectors focus towards being the first to attack enemies, or taunt them using active talents such as &9Bone Armor&7.

&7As a protector your main priority should be &cMaximum Health&7 and &eArmor&7. The best pieces with these stats are &eDiamond Armor&7 and its upgrades, as they'll provide the maximum amount of Armor points (and Toughness) as possible, and later on also Maximum Health.
&eKeep in mind that a tank's damage is mediocre compared to other builds. Its purpose is to tank, not to deal damage.
&eWarriors are melee builds that swing slow but hard.
&7They are the definition of a "Burst" class; as although they swing slow their damage will be high, just not as constant as a DPS build.
&eMages are versatile ranged builds that use magic of certain elements such as Arcane, Fire and Frost.
&7A Mage's job is to deal damage from a distance using magic casted from a Spell Book.

&7Your priority will depend on the path you decide to take; the element your want to focus on. As starting gear, you can get a &eWizard Staff&7 (or any staff of the specific element) and &eWizard Robes&7.
&eUnlock Tier II Guides for Specific Elements
&eRogues are melee builds that focus on attacking fast, dealing constant damage to targets.
&7They are the definition of a "DPS" class; the focus is towards constant damage, unlike Burst builds which are focused towards high damage without being constant.
&7Stat-wise the main priority is &eHaste&7, then &6Physical Damage&7. Gear-wise you should look for fast attacking weapons that are one-handed so you can dual wield them.
&eRangers are ranged builds that use weapons such as Bows, Crossbows or Guns to deal damage using projectiles.
&7They can be built as a DPS-oriented build, or Burst-oriented build, depending on the gear you take and stats you prioritize.
&7Main priority is &2Ranged Damage&7, obtained from talents and the gear you're using. If you want a faster fire rate, then you should also prioritize &aDraw Speed&7.
&eKeep in mind that archers are squishier.
&eAn alternative path that combines both Rogues and Mages.
&7With spellblades you can be a melee rogue that uses magic abilities. You can start with a Spellblade of any element you'd like, and its Techniques spellbook for the abilities.

&7Priorities should be a mix of both Physical Damage and the elemental power of your choosing. Fate choice can be either the fate of your element, or &9Shadow Techniques&7 if focusing more on attacking than spells.
&eThe Runic Invocations use Astral Magic, power from three elements: Arcane, Fire and Frost.
&7Runic Invocations are very strong when used right, but are the most difficult mages.
&7Now that you've reached enough level to get a Fate Talent, you should choose &9Knowledge Of Runes and Stars &7as it provides &eAstral Power&7.
&eHealers are supports that protect their allies by healing and giving magical temporal shields.
&7Your main focus is &eHoly Power&7, obtained through talents and gear. You can use the &6Holy Book&7 to cast healing spells.
&7You might also focus on a bit of defense, such as maximum health or movement speed to escape from targets, as your damage won't be as high.
&eKeep in mind that a healer's damage is mediocre compared to other builds. Its purpose is to heal, not to deal damage.
&eBards are supports that buff allies with damage, haste, healing and other buffs.
&cYou need to be in a party with your allies to give them buffs! &8(/openpac-parties command)

&7Bards are special, as they don't have a specific gear or stat. The only requirement is to have the &9A Bard's Tale&7 talent fated. They can use specific instruments to give specific buffs as described in the talent itself.

&7The short answer is hybrid. You can mix a Bard with another build or however you'd like. For example, you can be a support with damage by going into Archery gear, or mage, or healer! It's up to you.
&eUnlock Tier II Frost and Healer Guide
&eFrost focuses on dealing moderate damage while providing utility such as slowing down enemies.
&7Besides Frost Power, its main focus is &eSpell Haste&7 to cast as fast as possible. &eCritical Chance and Damage&7 are also good stats, although not a priority.
&eArcane is a high damage element focused on slower but harder spells.
&7It's the Burstiest of all 3. Focuses on &eCritical Damage&7 to maximize damage dealt by critical spells. &eCritical Chance&7 is also important, balancing out both is a good idea.
&7Your next upgrade if you choose to go as a Haste Rogue. The Assassin Set provides +5% Haste per piece, making it ideal for your build.
&7Physical Damage and Haste nodes should be top priority. For fate, choose &9Shadow Techniques&7 as it increases your Haste by a lot.
&7Your next upgrade is the Ranger Armor, as it provides the highest Ranged Damage, useful for your build.
&7Shortbows or Rapid Crossbows are the best options for DPS due to their low draw speed.
&7Pick all Ranged Damage options and as a Fate, get &9Sin'dorei Heritage
&7Your next upgrade is the Ranger Armor, as it provides the highest Ranged Damage, useful for your build.
&7Longbows or Heavy Crossbows are the best options for Burst due to their high damage. Alternatively you can use a Veiled Crossbow for slightly faster draw speeds.
&7Pick all Ranged Damage options and as a Fate, get &9Sin'dorei Heritage
&eThe next upgrade comes from killing a Mutant Skeleton to get its chestplate.
&7On the weapon side, you can also upgrade your Shortbow/Rapid Crossbow. For the accessories side, get the respective necklace and rings.
&eThe next upgrade is getting a better burst-oriented weapon.
&7You should upgrade to a Crystal Longbow / Ruby Heavy Crossbow. For the accessories side, get the respective necklace and rings.
&7As an upgrade, you can obtain the Prior set, which increases your holy power by a percentage instead of flat, boosting your Staff's Holy Power.
&7On Tier IV, you should obtain the &6Orion &7artifact, as it's the only bow artifact.
&7You can also branch out to three different spellbooks that interact directly with Orion depending on its upgrade tree;
&eFire is a high damage element that doesn't provide utility but provides very high damage with high critical chance focus.

&7As a Fire mage you deal high constant damage but lack of high burst options, to mitiage this you can focus more on &eCritical Damage&7, but your main priority should be &eCritical Chance&7 to have crits as constant as possible.
&7Your next upgrade as a tank is switching from Diamond to Netherite.
&7You can choose &9Righteous Hammers &7for a more dps focus, or &9Bone Armor&7 for pure resistance with a taunt.
&7As for Fate, your main focus should always be &9S'kellak's Blessing&7.
&7Netherite-Diamond will be your preferred upgrade from Netherite so you can upgrade to Sapphire afterwards.

&7Sapphire Armor is the direct upgrade from Netherite-Diamond, it has less total armor but provides +20 Maximum Health per piece, and a passive that reflects damage dealt to you. This means you take 30% less damage than with any other Armor from the getgo.
&7Tank is a very versatile class and go many other artifacts, but the armor is a massive staple for any tank player.
&7Upgrading your Holy Staff is an essential step before moving to your Artifact Weapon.
&7Obtain the &9Ekavar&7 Artifact Weapon and use its Upgrade Tree to evolve it to &eAd'anel, Secret of Ain&7.
&7Now that you've reached enough level to get a Fate Talent, you should choose &9Frost Archmage &7over anything.
&7Now that you've reached enough level to get a Fate Talent, you should choose &9Fire Archmage &7over anything.
&7Now that you've reached enough level to get a Fate Talent, you should choose &9Arcane Archmage &7over anything.
&7The Magus Set is your next upgrade for armor, crafted from Magus' drops, recommended for level 50 onwards, as Magus is a Void's Invasion Chapter II boss.
&7A Mageseeker Hat can be used if you want to proritize critical damage.

&7Many artifacts can be used as Spellblades, as most also grant a spell power of a kind. For fire, you have &6A'zhar&7. For Frost, you have &6Frostmourne&7. For Fire \& Arcane, you have &6Ash'edar&7, and finally, for Astral you have &6Supernova&7.
&eThe final choice for all mages is Ekavar, the Great Cinderstone Staff.
&7The difficulty will depend on the previous Spell Book you chose in Tier III.
&7Your next upgrade for Spellblades are the Runic armor sets, along with alternative spellblade spellbooks.
&eElemental Wizards are proficent in three elements; Fire, Frost and Arcane.
&7Your damage will not be as high as a devoted mage, but you will be very versatile, and later on obtain the means to cast multiple elements at once, known as &dAstral Magic&7.
&eWarriors are melee builds that swing slow but hard.
&7They are the definition of a "Burst" class; as although they swing slow their damage will be high, just not as constant as a DPS build.
&eWarriors are melee builds that swing slow but hard.
&7They are the definition of a "Burst" class; as although they swing slow their damage will be high, just not as constant as a DPS build.
&7Souldancer becomes your next upgrade after Assassin, as it provides the highest Haste out of any armor set of this tier.
&7An alternative path of the Rogue is a Monk, which uses Fist weapons. You can get a Fist of Fury for those builds.
&eDeath Knights are warriors who fell into Death's Call.
&7They can be high attack speed DPS focused (Frost), or Burst and AoE focused (Unholy).
&7Their main weapon are Runeblades, as they provide all three Death Knight powers.
&7The third Death Knight type is Blood. It's a tank class, that's why it's not included in this path. If you're interested in it, go towards the Protector's Path instead.
&eUnholy Death Knights are a Burst and AoE focused class.
&7Your preferred weapons are two handed Great Runeblades. For armor, choose the Plaguebringer set, which you will keep on future tiers.
&eFrost Death Knights are DPS builds that deal a mix of physical and frost damage.
&7Your preferred weapons are one handed Runeblades, and the Frozen Chamption armor set, which you will keep for future tiers.
&7For armor, upgrade it to the netherite tier, as they'll be the best for damage and protection.
&6Frostmourne&7 is made for Death Knights, making it the best choice for any Death Knight build.
&eBlood Death Knights have less protection, but high health and self-sustain.
&7This is an alternative route to going full protection, and instead focusing on sustaining yourself using the Tome of Vampiric Knowledge.
&7For artifact choice, you have &6Fury of a Thousand Fists&7 for monk builds, or &6Ash'edar&7 for swordman builds. A dagger artifact is coming in the future.
&eArtifact Option: &6Fury of a Thousand Fists &e(Monk's Way)
&eTitan's Shroud &7is your preferred armor because it has the highest &6Physical Damage &7stat, which is your main priority.
&7For an artifact choice, &6Thunderwrath&7 is the best as it interacts directly with the &9Warrior's Devotion&7 fate.
&7You can also make &eHero's Armor&7 as an alternative, as it provides &eLightning Power&7, which depending on your Thunderwrath upgrade it could be useful to you.
&eEnough Knowledge to understand all Tier IV Builds. Good job.
&eHint:&7 You masterized the builds, but what about your artifacts? Try doing some Mythical Challenges with them.
&7Your next upgrade as a off-tank is to make Crimson Guard Armor.
&7You can choose &9Decaying Devotion &7for a more dps focus, or &9Bone Armor&7 for pure resistance with a taunt.
&7As for Fate, you can choose whichever you prefer more.

&7Obtain the &9Apophis&7 Artifact Weapon and use its Upgrade Tree to either go more defensive(recommended with other players) with the oath of protection or go on the full offensive with the oath of Healing. The choice is yours.
&7Upgrading your Holy Weapon will not only increase your overall damage, but there is also a large variety of Holy Weapons you can choose from, even simply swords!
&7Using either Oath is also a great way of determining your playstyle, whilst they are very defensive focused, you have to decide if it is offense or defense you so desire.
&7Technically a side grade to the Prior Set, this Armor set is great for being a bit more tanky, whilst not losing out too much on damage, it is recommended to pair it with Prior armor pieces.
&7A Fun and very interesting Side-Grade is Mariums Guns!
&7Here is a List of the Current guns:
&dGatling gun:&r &7Nearly infinite spin time, decent dps but it will slow you down and is a bit inaccurate
&dHunter Cannon:&r &7Big boom! This weapon has the highest single target Damage out of them all, with a large cooldown!
&dHunter Blunderbuss:&r &7A general jack of all trades, shoots 3 projectiles each doing decent damage and having the highest Velocity out of them all, not the most accurate
&dHunter Pistol:&r &7The Blunderbuss' smaller brother is great for anyone who likes to shoot fast and having something to do whilst the other guys are reloading

&7&oEons ago, S'kellak fought against the eldritch beings, defeating and imprisoning the primordial being C'thulhu.

&7&oWhile its followers escaped, the chains imprisoning its half-brother, a tall hooded monster with tentacles, were broken free. S'kellak couldn't stop his escape, and for eons he never saw him again.
&7&oUntil now, after the attempt at domination from the remaining forces of the void, all realms lie the weakest they've been.
&e&oThe King in Yellow is back, and won't stop until all realms succumb to his new reign.
&7&oHace eones, S'kellak luchó contra los seres ancestrales, derrotando y encarcelando al ser primordial C'thulhu.

&7&oMientras sus seguidores escapaban, las cadenas que aprisionaban a su medio hermano, un monstruo alto encapuchado con tentáculos, se rompieron. S'kellak no pudo detener su escape, y durante eones no lo volvió a ver.
&7&oHasta que después del intento de dominación de las fuerzas restantes del vacío, todos los reinos se hallan en su punto más débil.
&e&oEl Rey de Amarillo ha vuelto, y no se detendrá hasta que todos los reinos sucumban a su nuevo reinado.
&7&oI have confirmed that it's him, the primordial being of all unholy things, known as Hastur.
&7&oThe Overworld is not safe, Hastur is great at twisting the minds of others, I will need you to come to Vaaz as soon as you can, before one of his twisted slaves come after you.
&7&oUse this beacon in the overworld, and I'll bring you to Vaaz.
&7&oAlso enchant your weapon with Smite, Hastur's followers are undead. You should be prepared for the worst."
&7&oHe confirmado que es él, el ser primordial de todas las cosas profanas, conocido como Hastur.

&7&oEl Overworld no está a salvo, Hastur es experto en retorcer las mentes de los seres. Necesito que vengas a Vaaz tan pronto como puedas, antes de que uno de sus esclavos retorcidos venga tras de ti.
&7&oUsa este faro en el Overworld, y te traeré a Vaaz.
&7&oTambién encanta tu arma con Castigo, los seguidores de Hastur son no-muertos. Debes estar preparado para lo peor."
&7The once archmage and leader of the Hex, dead in the hands of the Champions of Vaaz, was been resurrected by Hastur himself.
&7Now part of the cult and infused with Hastur's power, he has been chosen to sabotage the plans of S'kellak. Kidnapping and killing anyone who tries to travel to the Cinderstone Depths.
&eUse Smite to shred his barrier if you don't have the required spell power!
&7El pasado archimago y líder de los Hex, muerto a manos de los Campeones de Vaaz, ha sido resucitado por el mismísimo Hastur.

&7Ahora, como parte del culto e infundido con el poder de Hastur, ha sido elegido para sabotear los planes de S'kellak. Secuestrando y matando a cualquiera que intente viajar a las Profundidades de Piedraceniza.
&eUsa Castigo para romper su barrera si no tienes el poder de hechizo requerido!
&7Signal this beacon in the overworld to travel to Vaaz and meet S'kellak.
&7Llama este faro en el Overworld para viajar a Vaaz y encontrarte con S'kellak.
&eUse the Beacon of Hope and Travel to Vaaz
&7&oCorruption Infusions can be used to add corruption to Armor Pieces, which are useful for corruption scaled abilities.
&7&oActive Abilities from the Talent Tree have special effects and scaling with Corruption.
&7The Corruption Infusion Template can be found as loot in end cities.
&eUse in a Smithing Table along with the desired item and a material.
&7&oLas Infusiones de Corrupción pueden ser usadas para añadir corrupción a piezas de Armadura, lo cual es útil para habilidades que escalan con la corrupción.
&7&oLas Habilidades Activas del Árbol de Talentos tienen efectos especiales y escalan con la Corrupción.
&7El Molde de Infusión de Corrupción se puede encontrar como botín en las ciudades del End.
&eUsa en una Mesa de Herrería junto con el arma o armadura, y un material.
&7&oEtyr Infusions can be used to add Corruption Resistance to armor pieces, that counteract with your amount of corruption.
&7&oWhile abilities scale with Corruption, negative effects are based on your &nTotal Corruption&r&7&o, which accounts for your Etyr.
&7The Etyr Infusion Template can be found as loot in end cities.
&eUse in a Smithing Table along with the desired item and a material.
&7&oLas Infusiones de Etyr pueden ser usadas para añadir Resistencia a la Corrupción a las piezas de armadura, contrarrestando tu cantidad de corrupción.
&7&oMientras que las habilidades escalan con la Corrupción, los efectos negativos se basan en tu &nCorrupción Total&r&7&o, que tiene en cuenta tu Etyr.
&7El Molde de Infusión de Etyr se puede encontrar como botín en las ciudades del End.
&eUsa en una Mesa de Herrería junto con la armadura y un material.
&7The Beacon of Hope is broken, now, with no way to communicate with S'kellak, you will need to find a way to travel to Vaaz by yourself.
&eThis questline is coming on v4.0, along with the Cinderstone Depths dimension and the Kingdom of Vaaz!
&6Stay tuned! In the meantime, drink away your sorrows.

ftbquests.chapter.gear_mariums_soulslike: &bSoul Weaponry
Lunar Source
These two stones are going to be important into the creation of your soul equipment, remember to harvest a lot.
These stones can be found below the earth, somewhere in the deepslate layers, they aren't really common though.
Soul Crafting
Lost Souls are another source of power for these soul equipment and block creation, you can find some by smelting soul sand.
Living Iron
Soul Infused Ingots are one of the main ingredients in crafting the soul equipment as they contain the essence of lost souls.
Building Blocks of the Soul
Decorative blocks used in some structures of the great monsters hidden away. Great for a building theme too.
Soul Ammo

Boom! Headshot!

You Can't Talk to a Human, With a Shotgun in Their Hand..
The Hunter Blunderbuss is a shotgun that will use up silver bullets to release a blast of projectiles at the targets.
Walking Man-O-War

Say Hello to my little friend!

The Gatling Gun is a heavy gun that will take time to load up and start firing at a rapid pace. It'll eat up your bullets quickly so be sure to use this gun only when you have a lot of silver bullets.
Rabbit Hunting Season
Yes, you've read it, it's Big Chungus, gather 9 of these emeralds by killing Chunguses and craft the music disc.
False Soul Weapons
Cheap imitations of what a true soul equipment are, used by fallen fighters such as Remnants.
Lunar Tools
These tools are so durable, that they even might be stronger than diamond.
Guiding Moon
Such a peculiar compass, they seem to be pointing somewhere far away, where do they point to?

Find the Champion's Grave
Here stands a king who lost it all, end his false reign and emerge victorious.
Fall of a Kingdom
A powerful soul of a fallen leader and a heart of a decaying demon. You have freed the king who couldn't die.
Exorcism
A powerful soul of a great champion and a powerful essence of a ghost. You have freed the dead and now they have fallen back to the earth to rest.
Fallen Puppet
A powerful soul who was under control of a dark force and a pure moonstone radiating with powerful energy. But couldn't we have done anything else?
Retribution
You have brought back a fallen knight to their rightful body, and now you faced him in his former glory.
The Abyss Stares Back
A powerful soul of an embodiment of decay, the Wither, and it dropped a shard emanating chaotic energy, what is it for?
Essence of the Dragon
A powerful soul of the last known dragon in the End. You are now able to harness its power.
Moonwalker
The lunar ring grants the wearer the ability to launch magical waves for a short time, granting the wearer to even shoot from afar with just their hands.
Imitation Moon
Making use of the moonstone you found, you decided to see if you are able to create a powerful weapon.
It's lacking..
After inserting a powerful soul into the swords, they now seem to have awakened with the power of the moon.
ALERT!
This sword is interesting, it allows the holder to sense nearby hostiles, may be useful in a raid perhaps?
This weapon is a bit weird, it can transform into a different weapon with a different ability when wanted.
The Smell of Decay is near...
What must compel you to create such an item? To summon a great demon or something evil?

The robes of a dark sorcerer, infused with the power of souls, fairly durable.
Living Armor, but not really
You can hear the souls within the armor as they have been infused into the metal, more durable than iron.
Back in my Day..
These wandering demons are found in the crimson forests, wandering around as empty husks of killing instinct..
Can You Feel My Heart Beating?
A heart of a dying demon, still containing powerful vitality, perhaps we could make use of it?
It All Comes From The Heart
A condensed form of demon vitality, very disgusting if you think about it.
Iron Heart
An ingot made of infused demon hearts. It radiates demonic energy, perfect for soul equipment.
No One Can Stop Death...
A powerful scythe, crafted by using powerful soul metal to create a weapon that represents death. Summon the dead to do your bidding.
Long Forgotten...
Forgotten elite soldiers, can be found wandering around the Soul Sand Valley, but can be summoned to do your bidding.
One of the Forgotten
An equipment solely found by killing Evil Forlorns, put them to rest and be remembered.
It's Time to Purge
A weapon that do true magic damage based on each hit and fire aspect level, but only above a third of the target's health.
Shooting Star
A spear with the power of a speeding comet, ready to crash against any target.
Escape like the Wind
A good bow that can boost a wielder's speed the more their string is pulled in their non-dominant hand.
The Night is My Might
A simple but effective weapon that gets stronger when night falls.

A weapon containing demonic energy. It's sole purpose is to heal the wielder in exchange for blood of their targets.
THEN PAY WITH YOUR BLOOD!

An unevolved scythe that is ready to harvest souls, but what souls do you want to harvest?

A decimating axe that freezes enemies and makes them explode with chunks of ice upon death.
Gamble Your Life Away
A very peculiar staff that forces the wielder to gamble for effects that may or may not be beneficial to the wielder's battles.

A decimating mace wielded by a fallen knight, used to summon the souls of fallen soldiers.
By Your Will
A legendary sword with a mind of its own and can fight for you without holding it.
Blood Dancer
A scythe evolved from absorbing red souls, and allows the wielder to heal the more they attack mobs when ability is not on cooldown.
Among the Shadows
A scythe evolved from absorbing blue souls, and allows the wielder to have speed and damage during the first few seconds upon combat.
The Smell of Decay is Near..

Kill the Monarch of Chaos
Everything Starts
