ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.1B76F: &7&oThe Gauntlet, once the vigilant watcher and first herald of the Nether, hath now fallen to the dark embrace of the Void. Slaved upon being one of the Void's heralds, it now threatens its own realm with its destruction.
&7&oThou may find the Gauntlet locked within a monolithic prison. Shatter its eye, and thou shalt unleash the now corrupted beeing.
&eTip: &7This boss has strong hits and may one shot you if playing on Normal or Hard difficulty! Try to dodge or craft defensive potions!

&7&oEl Guantelete, una vez el vigilante y primer heraldo del Nether, ahora ha caído por el oscuro abrazo del Vacío. Esclavizado como uno de sus heraldos, amenaza con la destrucción de su propio reino, el Nether.
&7&oPuedes encontrar el Guantelete encerrado dentro de una prisión monolítica. Rompe su ojo y desatarás a la bestia ahora corrompida.
&eTip: &7Este jefe tiene ataques fuertes que pueden matarte de un golpe si juegas en dificultad Normal o Difícil! Intenta evadir los ataques o haz pociones defensivas.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.49C9D: &f &9The Night Lich, King of All Kings
&7&oThe long deceased souls of all the kings of the Kingdom of Ly'rell hath been resurrected and corrupted by the Void, now known as a single monster called the Night Lich.
&7&oThe Night Lich dwelleth upon the surface of the Overworld. Seek him in the colder biomes, within the remnants of a broken tower.
&7&oTo find this structure, use Souls Stars, dropped by undead creatures, which shall guide thee to the tower.
&eTip: &7This is a ranged boss, use a flying mount if you are melee, or a bow as secondary weapon!

&7&oLas almas de los antiguos reyes del Reino de Ly'rell, quienes han fallecido hace mucho tiempo, han sido resucitadas y corruptas por el Vacío, formando un gran monstruo ahora conocido como el Liche Nocturno.
&7&oEn los biomas más fríos, en la cima de los restos de una gran torre rota, yacen ellos atrapados.
&7&oPara encontrar esta estructura, usa las Estrellas de Alma, caídas de criaturas no muertas, que te guiarán hasta la torre.
&eTip: &7Este jefe es rango, usa una montura voladora si eres melee, o un arco como arma secundaria!
Obtain and use at least 4 Soul Stars
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.5063E: &7The Blackstone Golem, the Nether's final Herald, is a formidable creature that can be summoned through its ritual within the Nether.
&7Construct a 9x9 platform of any kind of Blackstone, with Chiseled Polished Blackstone Holders in the middle of each side but one block out. For more info, Check out the Nether questline.
&7Place a shard of gilded blackstone upon each holder to commence the ritual.
&7El Gólem de Piedra Negra, el último Heraldo del Nether, es un formidable golem que puede ser invocado a través de su propio ritual dentro del Nether.
&7Construye una plataforma de 9x9 utilizando cualquier tipo de Piedra Negra, con soportes de Piedra Negra Pulida Cincelada en el medio de cada lado.
&7Coloca un fragmento de piedra negra dorada sobre cada soporte para comenzar el ritual.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.759AA: &7The Old Champion's Remains can be found in its grave, hidden underground at the Overworld. This skeleton-like figure, who was once a great champion, now has been possessed by another being.
&8His attacks revolve around if he is guarded, switching between the shielding stances with the attacks.
&7Los Restos del Viejo Campeón se encuentran en su tumba, oculta bajo tierra en el Supramundo. Esta figura esquelética, que alguna vez fue un gran campeón, ha sido poseída por otro ser.
&8Sus ataques giran en torno a si está protegido, alternando entre posturas defensivas y ataques.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.10320: &7Obsidilith, the living monolith, is the pillar of the void's influence in the End.
&7Located at its own platform, a giant, eldritch structure that can be found floating in the end. To make it appear, use an eye of ender on the top of its platform.
&7Obsidilith, el monolito viviente, es el pilar de la influencia del vacío en El End.
&7Ubicado en su propia plataforma, una estructura gigantesca y extraña, que se encuentra flotando en El End. Para invocarlo, usa un ojo de ender en la cima de su plataforma.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.0E567: &7The raw essence of the end; the "Ender Eye", has been corrupted by the void's presence, turned into a horrific creature. It now needs to be saved from the void's influence to establish balance in the now desolated dimension.

&7The Eye can only be summoned at an Eye Shrine. The Shrine is built with a base of a 5×5 obsidian platform and a 3×3 centered crying obsidian layer. On all four corners an end rod has to get placed. The Eye can only get called in The end dimension.

&7La esencia pura del End; el "Ojo del Ender", ha sido corrompida por la presencia del vacío y transformada en una criatura horrorosa. Ahora debe ser salvado de esa maligna influencia para restablecer el equilibrio en la ahora desolada dimensión.

&7El Ojo solo puede ser invocado en un Santuario del Ojo. El Santuario se construye sobre una plataforma de obsidiana de 5x5 y una capa central de obsidiana llorosa de 3x3. En cada uno de los cuatro bordes se debe colocar una vara del end. En la cima del santuario, deberás tú sacrificar el huevo de dragón. El Ojo solo puede ser invocado en la dimensión del End.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.38359: &7This giant eye serves as the eternal watcher of the Prison of the Damned, residing within its own Lair deep in the Prison.
&7To challenge it, thou must first obtain a Vine Rune from the Promenade of the Condemned. With this rune, gain access to the Lair and face the eye in battle.
&7Este ojo gigante sirve como el vigilante eterno de la Prisión de los Condenados, residiendo en su propia Guarida, a las profundidades de la Prisión.
&7Para desafiarlo, primero debes obtener una Runa de Vid, obtenida en Paseo de los Condenados. Con esta runa, accede a su Guarida y enfréntate al ojo en batalla.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.48AAD: &7&oJean, once a noble and great emerald dragon, hath succumbed to the dark tendrils of the Void. Now corrupted and consumed by the Void's wrath, she dwelleth at the heart of the End, now known as the Ender Dragon.
&7&oShe is no simple feat, for the Void hath bestowed upon her formidable powers, driven by a strong and unquenchable rage known as the Ender.

&7&oTo unlock the ancient portal to the End, thou must seek out twelve of the sixteen unique eyes. These eyes are scattered throughout the vast expanse of the Overworld and the burning depths of the Nether.

&7&oJean, la noble y gran dragona esmeralda, ha sucumbido a las oscuras garras del Vacío. Ahora corrupta y consumida por la ira del mismo, ronda por el corazón del End, conocida ahora como la Dragona del Ender.
&7&oElla no es un reto sencillo, pues el Vacío le ha otorgado poderes formidables, impulsados por una furia fuerte e insaciable conocida como el Ender.

&7&oPara desbloquear el antiguo portal al End, debes buscar doce de los dieciséis ojos únicos. Estos ojos están esparcidos a lo largo de la vasta extensión del Overworld y las ardientes profundidades del Nether.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.343EF: &7&oDeep within Vaaz, the primordial volcano from where everything originated, dwells the Living Statue, S'kellak, creator of all things.
&7&oHe upholds the delicate balance across all dimensions and has waged countless battles to stave off the destruction of the realms.
&7&oEn las profundidades de Vaaz, el volcán primordial de donde todo se originó, habita la Estatua Viviente, S'kellak, el creador de todo lo que exista.
&7&oÉl mantiene el delicado equilibrio a lo largo de todas las dimensiones y ha luchado incontables batallas para evitar la destrucción de los reinos.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.7AE15: &o&7Yet now, after eons have passed, S'kellak lays weaker than ever before. A dire shadow blooms, an eldritch force known as The Void.

&o&7For ages, S'kellak has contained The Void, but with his strength now dwindling, the shadow surges, plotting to breach and destroy all realms. What once were serene beings shall be twisted into deadly aberrations, as corruption spreads its vile tendrils. The time of reckoning draws nigh.
&o&7Y ahora, tras eones, S'kellak yace más débil que nunca. Una sombría amenaza florece, una fuerza ancestral, conocida como El Vacío.

&o&7Durante eras, S'kellak ha contenido a este, pero con su poca fuerza, la sombra se alza, tramando corromper y destruir todos los reinos. Aquellos que antes eran seres serenos serán retorcidos en aberraciones mortales, mientras la corrupción extiende sus viles tentáculos. El tiempo de la destrucción se avecina.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.7CBAF: &o&7S'kellak hath discovered a source of unbalance within the realms. All dimensions now bear the taint of the void's horrid presence.
&o&7Once serene creatures have been twisted into powerful aberrations by its corrupting touch. The fate of the realms rests upon thee.
&o&7S'kellak descubrió una fuente de desequilibrio en los reinos. Todas las dimensiones ahora llevan la mancha de la horrenda presencia del Vacío.
&o&7Las criaturas que antes eran serenas han sido retorcidas en poderosas aberraciones por su toque corruptor. El destino de los reinos descansa sobre ti.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.63A18: &7&oWith the defeat of the dimensional threats and the restoration of the realms's balance, S'kellak, The Eternal Flame, spoke directly to the champion.
&6"In recognition of your valor and dedication,"&r &7&oS'kellak's voice resonated,&r &6"I bestow upon you a fragment of my essence, the Molten Core."
&7This gift, illuminated by S'kellak's power, signifies both the hero's triumph and a pledge of continued protection for the realms.
&7&oCon la derrota de las amenazas, y la restauración del equilibrio de los reinos, S'kellak, El Fuego Eterno, habló directamente al campeón.
&6"En reconocimiento a tu valor y dedicación,"&r &7&oLa voz de S'kellak resonó,&r &6"te otorgo un fragmento de mi esencia, el Núcleo Fundido."
&7Este regalo, iluminado por el gran poder de S'kellak, simboliza tanto el triunfo del héroe como una promesa de protección continua de los reinos.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.18E33: &7The Ender's Essence has been defeated, but its essence escaped the empty void, and a rift was formed in the End. Something is coming.
&7Deep in the end, strange voices are now whispering &8&o"The King in Yellow is near"&r.
&7La Esencia del Ender ha sido derrotada, pero su esencia escapó del vacío vacío, y una grieta se ha formado en el End. Algo se acerca.
&7En lo profundo del End, extrañas voces ahora susurran &8&o"El Rey en Amarillo se aproxima"&r.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.777FC: &eThe invasion has been halted, for now.&r

&6"We must prepare for what lies ahead — a new form of magic that we're unfamiliar with, known as the corruption. I'll go on a quest to discover a new material that could offer us a fighting chance against it.

&6As for you, that molten core is nothing but a vessel. You will need the essences of ancient beings. Once harnessed, these essences will empower it to be able to forge the formidable artifacts. It is your mission to obtain them." &e&oS'kellak explained.
&eLa invasión ha sido detenida, por ahora.&r

&6"Debemos prepararnos para lo que se avecina — una nueva forma de magia que desconocemos, conocida como la corrupción. Iré en busca de un nuevo material que podría darnos una oportunidad contra ella.

&6En cuanto a ti, ese Núcleo Fundido no es más que un recipiente. Necesitarás las esencias de seres antiguos. Una vez dominadas, estas esencias lo empoderarán para forjar armas de artefacto. Tu misión es obtenerlas." &e&oexplicó S'kellak.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.45A92: &7Baphomet, the Ancient Great Demon of Magic, holds a powerful demonic essence.

&7To summon it you must make a complex ritual using dark magic, which can be read using the Book of Shadows. This will require some work because no Novice is worthy to summon a Great Demon on their first Ritual, progress through the Book of Shadows to become a worthy summoner!
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.7C783: &7By using the Essence of Eventide on the Old Moon Altar, you will return the true heir back to its original body. This will result in the summoning of the Fallen Icon, a fierce empowered version of the Returning Knight with a fast and dangerous second phase. When summoned, it will affect anyone nearby with Weakness, Nausea, and Slowness.

&7Al usar la Essence of Eventide en el Antiguo Altar Lunar, devolverás al verdadero heredero a su cuerpo original. Esto resultará en la invocación del Ícono Caído, una versión feroz y más fuerte del Antiguo Campeón, con una segunda fase rápida y peligrosa. Al ser invocado, dará Debilidad, Náuseas y Lentitud a quienes estén cerca.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.569B4: &7From the spirit of a great leader
&7Must use the Shell Horn, found in the Deep Frozen Ocean. Call upon her in the Ice Maze, near water.
&7When fought, may she be weakened, or else she shall not die.
&7Debes usar el Cuerno encontrado en el Profundo Océano Congelado. Llámala en el Laberinto de Hielo, cerca del agua.
&7Al luchar, debe ser debilitada, o de lo contrario no caerá.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.601BD: &7The primitive seed of creation, the &9Primordial Abyss&7 has the most influence by the cosmic horrors. It is a corrupted land with its own corrupted kind of life, known as the &9aberrations&7.

&7La semilla primitiva de la creación, el &9Abismo Primordial&7, tiene la mayor influencia de los horrores cósmicos. Es una tierra corrompida con su propia forma de vida corrupta, conocidas como las &9aberraciones&7.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.25003: &7The hasturian wastes are a desolated land full of spikes that are known as the &eSpire Spikes&7. Some of these spikes have an unknown metal blessed by Hastur. It could be the best way to fight against corruption.

&7El desierto hasturiano es una tierra desolada llena de picos que son conocidos como los &ePinchos de Espiral&7. Algunos de estos picos contienen un metal desconocido, bendecido por Hastur. Podría ser la mejor manera de luchar contra la corrupción.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.5472D: &7With the defeat of the The Eye, the end has been affected by the void's higher forces, &dthe cosmic horrors&7. Eldritch beings that hold pure corruption in their veins.
&7Con la derrota de El Ojo, el End ha sido afectado por las fuerzas superiores del vacío, &dlos horrores cósmicos&7. Seres ancestrales que llevan corrupción pura en sus venas.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.250AE: &eThe Aberrations.&7 They are horrific creatures that live in the Primordial Abyss. Be careful with them, when they hit you, they will apply &9corruption&7 to you, which is stackable. You don't want them to hit you multiple times.

&eLas Aberraciones.&7 Son criaturas horribles que habitan en el Abismo Primordial. Ten cuidado con ellas, cuando te golpean, te aplican &9corrupción&7, la cual es acumulable. No querrás que te golpeen varias veces.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.40BF6: &7The metal from the Spire Spikes, &2Etyr&7, has an unique attribute, it is &2resistant to corruption&7. We could use this metal to prevent the cosmic horrors from corrupting the end.
&7El metal de los Picos de Agujas, &2Etyr&7, tiene una propiedad única: es &2resistente a la corrupción&7. Podríamos usar este metal para evitar que los horrores cósmicos corrompan el End.
ftbquests.chapter.main_story.quest.4AEBB: &6"Let's start the preparations for the summoning.
&6First, we will need a summoning pedestal." &e&oS'kellak explained.

Hello, young technician! I am here to help guide you through the factory world of Modern Industrialization. It may be a bit overwhelming at first, but it won't hurt too much, right?

Steam machines will accept inputs from any side, be it items, steam or another fluid. You can lock their slots by clicking on the lock in the interface. Locked slots only accept one type of item or fluid.
Bronze Ingots
Mechanical Press, but more Modern!
This is probably the first machine you will want to build as it saves your hammer from hammering away their durability.
Full Steam Ahead!

Oh, That's Hot! Remember that the boiler is an advanced machinery that is able to power several machines at once and saves fuel efficiently. Don't forget to give it water or else the fuel wastes burning to ashes.

Steam machines need steam to function, and that's exactly what the boiler provides. It will slowly use fuel to heat up. When it's hot enough, it will start to produce steam. Don't forget to feed it with water or your fuel will burn for nothing.
You can also smelt water buckets into steam buckets. Make your first Bronze Compressor before the boiler to save a lot on the plates!

It probably looks expensive to you right now, but don't forget that you can triple ores with the Forge Hammer. Also, as soon as you will have your first two machines, it will become more than twice less expensive!
The boiler will automatically produce and send steam to adjacent machines, up to 8 millibuckets per tick.

Bronze machines can only process recipes up to 2 EU/t, meaning that the recipe will use 2 Energy Units per Tick. As 1 millibucket of steam = 1 EU, a boiler at max temperature can power 4 machines simultaneously!
Sauna but for metals

Reduce, Reuse, Reforge

I'll cut you!

&dThe Endgame
Using this very delicate material, it will be used to create the best of the best machinery for UNLIMITED POWER!!
The most powerful machine upgrade ever. Have a look at yourself: Was it worth it?
The Fusion Reactor is the ultimate energy source, to make it work requires a large amount of energy and it can combine Deuterium, Tritium, and/ or Helium-3 into Helium Plasma.
Do not underestimate SCIENCE! Without it, we wouldn't have been able to create the best energy producer of the mod!
A large multiblock whose purpose is to generate massive amounts of energy by consuming nuclear fuel.
It can produce 100s of times more EU/t than diesel. It comes in several sizes from small to large.

How it works under the hood can be a bit overwhelming, nevertheless, you don't need to understand the details to be able to design a powerful reactor. We recommend that you experiment with various designs in creative mode until you find one that suits you.

Note that the Nuclear Reactor cannot explode, emit radiation, or otherwise damage the map. The only thing that it can damage is the items you put in it if the temperature gets too high (more on this later). You should feel free to experiment, and enjoy your new life as a nuclear scientist!
The main component is the Nuclear Casing which is made with Nuclear Alloy : a mix of cadmium, beryllium and blastproof alloy.
The upper part of the structure accepts Nuclear Item or Fluid Hatches (or simple casings). Those are the inputs and outputs of the reactor.
Each hatch has one input (either item or fluid) and two outputs. The input slots will form a grid, displayed in the reactor GUI (accessible by right-clicking on the controller).

Each hatch has a temperature and stores heat which can be dissipated in several ways. The heat will naturally move to an adjacent hatch or to the outside if the hatch is on the edge (the heat is then lost). The speed of this process is equal to the hatches content's heat transfer coefficient (shown in REI) times the temperature difference. The heat can also be extracted in a fluid hatch by producing steam. A temperature above an item's maximum temperature will destroy it.

The core nuclear reactor elements are neutrons. Those are produced by the nuclear fuel. There are two type of neutrons, fast and thermal : the fast carry energy while the thermal do not. Neutrons move in a straight line until they encounter an element or exit the reactor (for fast neutrons, their energy is then lost). The flow of neutrons is shown in the reactor GUI.

When a neutron encounters a non-empty hatch, two things can happen : the neutron is absorbed or scattered. A scattered neutron will randomly change direction. If the scattered neutron is fast, it has a chance of slowing down, becoming a thermal one. This transfers the energy from the neutron to the hatch in the form of heat. An absorbed neutron stops its course and also transfers its energy if it was a fast neutron.

The number of absorbed neutrons in a single hatch can be seen in the GUI. The probability for each processes is shown in REI. Those will strongly depend on the hatch's content and the neutron type (fast or thermal). Nuclear fuels absorb thermal neutrons far better.

When a neutron, either fast or thermal, is absorbed in nuclear fuel, more neutrons are generated. Those are always fast neutrons and have random direction. Their generation is accompanied by the direct release of energy in the form of additional heat in the hatch.

Above a certain threshold, the number of generated neutrons will decrease with the temperature until reaching zero. This process wastes some energy, but guarantees the stability of the reactor. The number of generated neutrons (and effective efficiency), the direct energy and the temperature threshold are in REI.

Each nuclear component has maximum number of absorptions. When reached, the item is either destroyed or transformed into a depleted version. This is particularly useful for nuclear fuel because some part of the U238 is transformed into Plutonium in the depleted version, meaning some of it can be transformed back into fuel.

The same thing happens for fluids: a bit of fluid is transformed after each neutron absorption. This can be used to mass produce useful isotopes like deuterium and tritium. In both cases, the outcome is shown in REI.

The book will help you understand the mod if needed.

ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest.713D81FCEC: Dielectric Rods are one of the main building parts in creating another piece of machinery part.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest.2C0442E289: The Wrench is a tool used to rotate powah machinery, config with energy cables and even link certain electric rods to energizing orbs.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest.18724D9656: By itself, it's not useful, but after using it on a Zombie or a Husk, it will upgrade into the Player Aerial Pearl.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest.44EE18F81A: Capacitors are the next parts that are used to create a variety of electric machinery, you can either combine two capacitors to get a large one or cut one to get two tiny capacitors.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest.4E0F2BFF1B: Thermo Plates are an essential part used to create and upgrade your generators.

ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest.5C78BBC340: This Binding Card will allow wireless charging across dimensions, but must use a binding card on an Enderman to work.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest.15A88EE622: Energizing Rods are a type of machinery that energizes items contained in an energizing orb and transforms them.
ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest.2620A7CCFB: As the name implies, Energizing Orb receives electric charge and uses it on items to upgrade machinery. The higher tier the material, the more power required to energize.

ftbquests.chapter.powah.quest.37CD6EBB40: 3rd Tier Capacitors used to upgrade to Blazing Machinery.
